performance_links.scope_note: Source-linked Option II epoch contraction under convex components satisfying the explicitly stated quadratic L-smoothness inequality, gamma-strong convexity of the average, exact gradients, uniform sampling/output, positive denominator and alpha<1. This is the proof-supported quadratic smoothness interpretation of Theorem 1, with the Eq. (5) discrepancy retained; read the full linked statement and restrictions.

variants.cost: Source charges n+2m component-gradient evaluations per epoch without caching; n+m when all n snapshot component gradients are cached. The full gradient costs n component evaluations. Each inner step also uses O(d) vector arithmetic; this is separate from gradient evaluation cost. Caching n arbitrary d-dimensional gradients costs O(nd) storage. A direct implementation may retain the inner iterates for output selection; the source gives no mandatory output-selection storage implementation or computational lower bound.
variants.implementation_details_ref: PDF p.4 Figure 1; p.3 Section 2 resource paragraph
variants.name: SVRG Option II
variants.output: Random snapshot wtilde_S; each epoch chooses among w_0,...,w_{m-1}, excluding w_m.
public_inputs: n component gradient functions, initial snapshot wtilde_0, positive learning rate eta, positive integer epoch length m, chosen number of epochs S
For the stated convergence regime: L and gamma with 0 < gamma <= L
variants.query_and_update: For t=1,...,m draw i_t uniformly from {1,...,n}, independently of preceding draws conditional on the current epoch history. Query grad psi_{i_t}(w_{t-1}) and grad psi_{i_t}(wtilde), then set v_t=grad psi_{i_t}(w_{t-1})-grad psi_{i_t}(wtilde)+mu and w_t=w_{t-1}-eta*v_t. After the epoch choose J uniformly from {0,...,m-1}, independently of its trajectory, and set wtilde_s=w_J. Uniform sampling makes explicit the averaging used by the source proof.
variants.requirements: Exact indexed component gradients and permission to evaluate the same component at current and snapshot points. Linked convergence requires every component to be convex and satisfy psi_i(x)<=psi_i(y)+<grad psi_i(y),x-y>+(L/2)||x-y||_2^2 for all x,y, and the average to be gamma-strongly convex. The quadratic smoothness condition is the explicit interpretation used by the source proof; literal Eq. (5) lacks the square. Additional tuning and randomness conditions are in the linked theorem.
variants.state_and_initialization: Start from any fixed wtilde_0 in R^d. At epoch s set wtilde=wtilde_{s-1}, compute mu=n^{-1} sum_i grad psi_i(wtilde), and set w_0=wtilde.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: Run a prescribed finite number S of epochs and return wtilde_S. Figure 1 itself specifies an indefinite outer loop, not a data-dependent stopping certificate. Theorem 1 uses alpha=1/[gamma*eta*(1-2L*eta)*m]+2L*eta/(1-2L*eta)<1 with eta>0 and 1-2L*eta>0. No new accuracy-based stopping theorem is asserted here.

use_restrictions: Linked performance is restricted to the explicit quadratic smoothness interpretation of the source proof. Preserve the Eq. (5) discrepancy; no author correction or equivalence with its literal unsquared display is established.
